actor.description: [APT-C-23](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1028) is a threat group that has been active since at least 2014.(Citation: symantec_mantis) [APT-C-23](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1028) has primarily focused its operations on the Middle East, including Israeli military assets. [APT-C-23](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1028) has developed mobile spyware targeting Android and iOS devices since 2017.(Citation: welivesecurity_apt-c-23)
actor.analyst_notes: 2026-09 migration: removed or re-scoped legacy geography-derived state sponsorship, generated espionage motivation, and alias evidence that was not source-specific. 2026-09 workbook-alias migration: workbook-only aliases were removed because the source workbook is not retained in this repository. attribution.assessment: Meta attributed the observed Arid Viper campaigns to state-sponsored cyber espionage operations with high confidence.
attribution.analyst_notes: Meta could not conclusively confirm prior reporting that linked Arid Viper to the cyber arm of Hamas. State sponsorship is therefore retained without naming a sponsor organization or attribution country.
